# AGY HUD **A [`claude-hud`](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud)-inspired real-time status line plugin for Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9%2B-3776AB.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-Zero-40A02B.svg)](#architecture) **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## Why AGY HUD? `agy-hud` brings the clean, airy, zero-clutter telemetry design of `claude-hud` natively to **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**: - **Zero external dependencies** — Pure Python 3 standard library (`>=3.9`). No `npm install`, no build step, no `jq`, works across Linux, macOS, WSL, and Windows. - **Zero symbol collisions** — Avoids exotic glyphs that trigger CJK fallback overlapping; uses crisp `[Model ◕ xhigh]` effort dials (`○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●`), classic `project git:(main* ↑1)`, and adaptive **10 / 6 / 4-cell** progress bars. - **Column-aligned responsive layout** — Merges horizontally on wide terminals and gracefully stacks with **CJK-accurate vertical label alignment** on medium/narrow screens. - **Dual color families + Auto Light/Dark** — Context bars use Green → Yellow → Red; 5h/7d Quota bars use Sapphire → Peach → Red. Automatically detects Antigravity's `colorScheme` (`Catppuccin Latte` on light, `Catppuccin Macchiato` on dark), plus **Tokyo Night**, **Nord**, **Gruvbox Dark**, and **ANSI 16-color**. - **Live activity tracking** — Streams Antigravity's `transcript.jsonl` to show currently running tools (`◐`), completed tool counts (`✓ ×N`), and active/recent subagents. - **Native Antigravity Plugin** — Ships with `plugin.json`, `agy-hud-setup`, and `agy-hud-configure` guided skills. --- ## Installation ### Option 1: Install as an Antigravity Plugin (Recommended) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Kiterlin/agy-hud ``` Then ask Antigravity inside `agy`: > Set up and enable the `agy-hud` status line Or run the one-line installer directly: ```bash python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --install ``` ### Option 2: Clone from GitHub ```bash git clone https://github.com/Kiterlin/agy-hud.git python3 agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --install ``` On Windows (PowerShell 7): ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Kiterlin/agy-hud.git python agy-hud\bin\agy-hud.py --install ``` > **Note:** Your previous `statusLine` block in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` is automatically backed up to `agy-hud.backup.json` and restored cleanly if you run `--uninstall`. --- ## Layout & Width Adaptation ### Wide Terminal (`≥ 112 cols`) ```text [Gemini 4 Neon ◕ xhigh] │ agy-hud git:(main* ↑1) │ Build agy-hud plugin Context ██░░░░░░░░ 18% (189k/1M) · cache 92% · tok 214k │ 5h █████████░ 85% (3h 10m) │ 7d ███████░░░ 68% (5d 23h) ◐ run_command: python3 -m unittest | ✓ read_file ×12 | ✓ edit_file ×5 | ✓ search_web ×2 ◐ Codebase Researcher [flash] (14s) ``` ### Standard Terminal (`80–111 cols`, vertically column-aligned bars) ```text [Gemini 4 Neon ◕ xhigh] │ agy-hud git:(main* ↑1) │ Build agy-hud plugin Context ██░░░░░░░░ 18% (189k/1M) · cache 92% · tok 214k 5h █████████░ 85% (3h 10m) │ 7d ███████░░░ 68% (5d 23h) ◐ run_command: python3 -m unittest | ✓ read_file ×12 | ✓ edit_file ×5 ``` ### Narrow Terminal (`< 80 cols`, 6/4-cell bars, zero wrapping glitches) ```text [Gemini 4 Neon ◕ xhigh] │ agy-hud git:(main*?) Context █░░░ 5% (57k/1M) · cache 90% · tok 70k 5h ███░ 85% (3h 10m) │ 7d ███░ 68% (5d 23h) ✓ read_file ×12 | ✓ edit_file ×5 ``` --- ## Configuration Use the bundled **`agy-hud-configure`** skill inside Antigravity, use CLI flags, or edit `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/agy-hud.json` directly (changes apply immediately on the next UI refresh): ```bash # Switch preset / theme / language / layout via CLI python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --configure \ --preset full \ --layout expanded \ --theme auto \ --language en \ --bar-style block # Preview across terminal widths in your terminal python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --preview # Diagnose wiring, Python version, theme detection, and latency python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --doctor ``` ### Presets | Preset | Included Modules | | :--- | :--- | | `full` *(default)* | Model + effort, project + git (`* ? ↑ ↓`), title, context bar + tokens + cache hit + cumulative tokens, 5h/7d quotas, active alerts, live tools & subagents | | `essential` | Model + effort, project + git, context bar + tokens, 5h/7d quotas, alerts, live tools & subagents | | `minimal` | Model + effort, context bar, 5h quota bar, critical alerts | ### Full `agy-hud.json` Reference ```json { "preset": "full", "layout": "expanded", "language": "en", "theme": "auto", "pathLevels": 1, "showSeparators": false, "display": { "showModel": true, "showEffort": true, "showProject": true, "showGit": true, "showGitAheadBehind": true, "showSessionTitle": true, "showContextBar": true, "showContextTokens": true, "showCacheHit": true, "showSessionTokens": true, "showQuota": true, "showQuotaBar": true, "showQuotaReset": true, "showStatusBadges": true, "showTools": true, "showAgents": true, "showDuration": false, "quotaValueMode": "remaining", "barStyle": "block", "contextWarningThreshold": 70, "contextCriticalThreshold": 85, "quotaWarningThreshold": 50, "quotaCriticalThreshold": 20, "toolsMaxVisible": 4, "agentsMaxVisible": 3, "customLine": "" }, "colors": {} } ``` ### Built-in Themes `auto` *(default: `catppuccin-latte` on light, `catppuccin-macchiato` on dark)*, `catppuccin-latte`, `catppuccin-macchiato`, `tokyo-night`, `nord`, `gruvbox-dark`, and `ansi` (16-color). Any color role (`model`, `project`, `git_wrap`, `git_branch`, `ctx_ok`, `usage_ok`, `warn`, `peach`, `crit`, `text`, `subtext`, `overlay`, `bar_empty`) can be overridden with `#RRGGBB` in `colors`. ### Languages - `en` — English *(default)* - `zh-Hans` — 简体中文 - `zh-Hant` — 繁體中文 --- ## Architecture ```text Antigravity CLI ──(stdin JSON)──▶ bin/agy-hud.py ──▶ stdout (ANSI HUD) │ ├── reads ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/agy-hud.json ├── reads ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json (theme) ├── fast git status (--no-optional-locks + .git/HEAD fallback) └── tail-parses transcript.jsonl (tools & subagents) ``` ## Development & Testing ```bash # Run unit tests (zero external deps) python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v # Validate Antigravity plugin manifest & skills strictly agy plugin validate . --strict # Test stdin rendering with sample payload python3 bin/agy-hud.py < examples/sample-payload.json ``` ## Credits & License Inspired by [jarrodwatts/claude-hud](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud) and the [Catppuccin](https://catppuccin.com/) color palette. Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

# AGY HUD **受 [`claude-hud`](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud) 启发的 Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) 实时 HUD 状态栏插件** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9%2B-3776AB.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![零依赖](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E4%BE%9D%E8%B5%96-%E9%9B%B6%E5%A4%96%E9%83%A8%E4%BE%9D%E8%B5%96-40A02B.svg)](#工作原理) [English](README.md) | **简体中文**
--- ## 核心特性 `agy-hud` 将 `claude-hud` 清爽、舒展、信息层次分明的终端 HUD 设计原生带到 **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**： - **纯 Python 3 零依赖**：仅使用标准库（`Python >= 3.9`），免 `npm install`、免编译、免 `jq`，跨 Linux / macOS / WSL / Windows 开箱即用。 - **拒绝图标挤压与错位**：摒弃容易触发 CJK 字体回退重叠的冷门符号，采用 `[Gemini 4 Neon ◕ xhigh]` 推理月相刻度（`○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●`）、经典 `agy-hud git:(main* ↑1)`，以及 **10 / 6 / 4 格** 自适应进度条。 - **列对齐响应式排版**：宽屏横向合并；常规与窄屏自动拆行，并按 CJK 真实显示宽度做左侧标签补齐，让多条进度条垂直齐边、绝不乱断行。 - **双色系区分 + 明暗自动适配**：上下文采用绿→黄→红，5h/7d 配额采用青蓝→橙→红，一眼区分。默认自动检测 Antigravity 的 `colorScheme`（浅色自动 **Catppuccin Latte**，深色自动 **Catppuccin Macchiato**），同时内置 **Tokyo Night**、**Nord**、**Gruvbox Dark** 与 **ANSI 16 色**。 - **实时工具与子 Agent 活动追踪**：流式截尾读取 Antigravity 的 `transcript.jsonl`，实时展示正在运行的工具目标（`◐`）、已完成工具统计（`✓ ×N`）及活跃子 Agent 状态。 - **原生 Antigravity 插件**：内置标准 `plugin.json` 与 `agy-hud-setup` / `agy-hud-configure` 两个交互式引导技能。 --- ## 快速安装 ### 方式一：作为 Antigravity 插件安装（推荐） ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Kiterlin/agy-hud ``` 随后在 `agy` 对话框中直接说： > 帮我安装并启用 agy-hud 状态栏 或者直接在终端执行一键安装： ```bash python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --install ``` ### 方式二：Git 克隆安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Kiterlin/agy-hud.git python3 agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --install ``` Windows（PowerShell 7）： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Kiterlin/agy-hud.git python agy-hud\bin\agy-hud.py --install ``` > **安全备份**：安装时会自动把 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` 中原有的 `statusLine` 配置备份到 `agy-hud.backup.json`，随时可通过 `--uninstall` 一键无损还原。 --- ## 配置与预览 你可以在 `agy` 中唤醒 **`agy-hud-configure`** 技能进行交互式配置，也可以用 CLI 参数或直接编辑 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/agy-hud.json`（无需重启，下一次刷新立即生效）： ```bash # 通过 CLI 快速切换预设 / 主题 / 中文标签 / 进度条样式 python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --configure \ --preset full \ --layout expanded \ --theme auto \ --language zh-Hans \ --bar-style block # 在终端直接查看多宽度实时渲染效果 python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --preview # 环境诊断（检查配置、主题检测、渲染耗时） python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud.py --doctor ``` ### 内置预设 | 预设 | 包含模块 | | :--- | :--- | | `full` *(默认)* | 模型与推理档位、项目与 Git（`* ? ↑ ↓`）、会话标题、上下文进度条 + 缓存命中率 + 会话累计 Token、5h/7d 配额、按需状态徽章、实时工具与子 Agent 活动行 | | `essential` | 模型与推理档位、项目与 Git、上下文进度条、5h/7d 配额、状态徽章、实时工具与子 Agent 活动行（隐藏标题、缓存与累计 Token） | | `minimal` | 极简核心：模型与推理档位、上下文进度条、5h 配额条、关键预警 | ### 支持主题与语言 - **主题**：`auto`（默认，自动切换 `catppuccin-latte` / `catppuccin-macchiato`）、`catppuccin-latte`、`catppuccin-macchiato`、`tokyo-night`、`nord`、`gruvbox-dark`、`ansi`（16 色），并支持在 `colors` 中用 `#RRGGBB` 覆写任意色槽。 - **语言**：`en`（英文）、`zh-Hans`（简体中文）、`zh-Hant`（繁體中文）。 --- ## 工作原理 ```text Antigravity CLI ──(stdin JSON)──▶ bin/agy-hud.py ──▶ stdout (ANSI HUD) │ ├── 读取 ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/agy-hud.json ├── 自动检测 settings.json 的 colorScheme（明/暗主题） ├── 极速 git status（--no-optional-locks + .git/HEAD 降级） └── 截尾解析 transcript.jsonl（工具调用 & 子 Agent） ``` ## 本地开发与校验 ```bash # 运行零依赖单元测试 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v # 用 Antigravity 官方校验器严格检查插件清单与技能 agy plugin validate . --strict # 使用示例 JSON 测试标准输入渲染 python3 bin/agy-hud.py < examples/sample-payload.json ``` ## 致谢与开源协议 设计灵感源自 [jarrodwatts/claude-hud](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud) 与 [Catppuccin](https://catppuccin.com/) 配色方案。 基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。
